def test_orders_end_to_end_workflow():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    # 1. Register User
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "John",
        "lastName": "Doe"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 2. Add Address
    address_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json()["id"]

    # Verify Address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["city"] == "London"

    # 3. Add Card
    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    # Verify Card
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["expires"] == "12/25"

    # 4. Get Catalogue Item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item = items[0]
    item_id = item["id"]
    unit_price = item["price"]

    # 5. Add to Cart
    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify Cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) == 1
    assert cart_items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert cart_items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    # 6. Place Order
    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order["id"]
    assert order["customer"]["username"] == username
    assert order["total"] == 2 * unit_price

    # 7. Verify Order
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_order = resp.json()
    assert fetched_order["id"] == order_id

    # 8. Verify Payment
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    payments = resp.json()
    assert len(payments) > 0
    assert payments[0]["orderId"] == order_id
    assert payments[0]["authorised"] is True

    # 9. Verify Shipping
    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment["orderId"] == order_id

def test_user_registration_and_conflict():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Jane",
        "lastName": "Doe"
    }

    # Register
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify Login
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Register again (Conflict)
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify Customer Retrieval
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer = resp.json()
    assert customer["username"] == username
    assert customer["firstName"] == "Jane"

def test_carts_management():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Get a valid item from catalogue
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    item_id = items[0]["id"]
    unit_price = items[0]["price"]

    # Add item to cart
    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item in cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 1

    # Update item quantity
    updated_item = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 5,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=updated_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify updated quantity
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    # Delete item
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Delete cart
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_catalogue_and_tags():
    # Get tags
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    tags_data = resp.json()
    assert "tags" in tags_data
    tags = tags_data["tags"]
    assert len(tags) > 0

    tag = tags[0]

    # Get catalogue by tag
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0

    item_id = items[0]["id"]

    # Get specific item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item = resp.json()
    assert item["id"] == item_id
    assert tag in item["tag"]

    # Get size by tag
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/size?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    size_data = resp.json()
    assert "size" in size_data
    assert size_data["size"] >= len(items)

    # Negative test: non-existent item
    fake_id = f"fake_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{fake_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_payment_and_shipping_standalone():
    order_id = f"order_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Authorize payment
    payment_payload = {
        "address": {
            "city": "Berlin",
            "country": "Germany",
            "number": "5",
            "postcode": "10115",
            "street": "Mitte"
        },
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {
            "ccv": "111",
            "expires": "10/26",
            "longNum": "1111222233334444"
        },
        "customer": {
            "firstName": "Max",
            "lastName": "Mustermann"
        },
        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth["authorised"] is True
    assert auth["orderId"] == order_id

    # Verify payment authorization
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0]["authorised"] is True

    # Ship request
    shipping_payload = {
        "address": payment_payload["address"],
        "itemCount": 3,
        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("shipping-http", "/shipping"), json=shipping_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment["orderId"] == order_id
    assert "trackingNumber" in shipment

    # Verify shipment
    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_shipment = resp.json()
    assert fetched_shipment["orderId"] == order_id
    assert fetched_shipment["trackingNumber"] == shipment["trackingNumber"]

def test_carts_merge():
    session_id = f"session_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Get a valid item from catalogue
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    item_id = items[0]["id"]
    unit_price = items[0]["price"]

    # Add item to session cart
    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Merge session cart into customer cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify customer cart has the item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    merged_items = resp.json()
    assert len(merged_items) == 1
    assert merged_items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert merged_items[0]["quantity"] == 2
